profile.name: Lawrence Berry
profile.summary: Full-stack web developer with 15+ years' experience delivering Ruby on Rails and JavaScript SaaS products, including 13 years as founding engineer of a geospatial mapping platform. Comfortable across the stack, from AWS infrastructure and CI/CD automation to client-facing delivery. Looking for a senior, staff or lead role owning a product long-term.
profile.personal: Outside of work: tinkering with hardware and software, climbing, travelling, learning new languages, cooking, and teaching my daughter to code.

bullets: Started coding at age 11.
Comfortable on the MS-DOS command line by age 12.
Ran Linux on my home system throughout my teens.
Provided informal IT support for the family business as a teenager, troubleshooting PCs and everyday technical problems.
Selected for the Glasgow Select rugby squad (2000).
Set the school high jump record (2001).
Won the school Computing Prize (2001).
Selected into the Software Engineering stream, capped at the top 20 students from the wider Computing Science intake.

Secured one of Reuters' 3 annual internship places, reserved for the top 3 students in Glasgow University's 20-place Software Engineering programme — one of the most sought-after placements in the class.
Built a training-tracking tool solo, deployed company-wide to monitor security-course completion for ISO certification.
Promoted from Telemarketing Agent to IT Manager / Lead Developer in Jan 2008.
Delivered 100+ client projects for financial institutions, stock market index providers, and other blue-chip companies.
Recruited a 4-person development team, supporting growth in interviewer capacity from 12 to 120 seats.
Built a Rails/MySQL CATI platform, powering the 10x growth in interview capacity.
Acted as primary client and management technical liaison, handling queries and demonstrating platform capabilities.
Founding engineer on a Ruby on Rails / Google Maps API geospatial SaaS platform, growing with the company from MVP to a multi-client product over 13 years.
Owned full project delivery end-to-end, scaling from 8 to 40 concurrent client projects over 13 years.
Led a 3-person development team, shipping concurrent client projects over the platform's 13-year lifecycle.
Turned single-project clients Shell and BP into 10+ year multi-project accounts, alongside long-term clients BT and BUPA.
Cut deployment time in half using AWS automation, reducing deployment issues by roughly 80%.
Migrated legacy Rails views to dedicated React.js frontends, decoupling the UI layer from the backend.
